Reconstructed signed integral Morse differential ∂4=0; 3-skeleton wedge of 3 S3, π3≅Z3, so 4-cells attach nullhomotopically, proving integral wedge 3 S3 and 3 S4. Exact mod2 boundary ranks (1,11,55,137,163,62) corroborate reduced Betti (0,0,0,3,3,0). Independently reconstructed critical integral cycle lifts and all 24 signed S4 actions, obtaining characters χ3=(3,−1,3,0,−1), χ4=(3,−1,−1,0,1), which split over Q as sgn ⊕ S^(2,2) and S^(2,1,1). S4 automorphisms follow from its four intrinsic triangles and reversal connections. No integral lattice splitting is claimed.
